description: Move multiple messages to a different folder in one operation. Provide EITHER `uids` (an explicit list) OR `match` (search criteria — same shape as search_messages), not both. Set `dryRun: true` to preview what would be moved without making changes. Note: moved messages get new UIDs in the destination folder.

match.description: Search criteria; matching messages will be moved (mutually exclusive with `uids`)

attachmentName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on attachment filenames (e.g. "invoice", ".pdf"). Implies hasAttachment.

attachmentType.description: Case-insensitive MIME-type prefix filter on attachments (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/"). Implies hasAttachment.

uids.description: Explicit UIDs to move (mutually exclusive with `match`)

name: bulk_move
